content:
## 本页定位：下载后的安装和排错

如果你只是想找《遗忘之海》官网、官网下载、Steam、TapTap、iOS 或 Android 入口，先打开 [遗忘之海下载主入口](/zh/sea/download)。本页主要解决“已经找到入口后怎么安装、怎么更新、为什么卡校验、空间不够怎么办、账号区服怎么确认”。

## 先给结论

截至 **2026 年 7 月 23 日 10:00**，《遗忘之海》已经从 7 月 9 日 PC 公测进入移动端首发阶段。今天下载页最重要的不是继续写“等待上线”，而是把入口、账号、区服、容量、预下载后更新和排错路径讲清楚。

## 下载入口怎么选

| 入口 | 适合谁 | 首日检查 |
|---|---|---|
| 官方启动器 | 想跟官网公告、活动和账号体系走的 PC 玩家 | 确认启动器版本、补丁校验和账号绑定 |
| Steam | 想用 Steam 库管理的 PC 玩家 | 先看商店地区、语言和账号说明 |
| iOS | 手机首发新玩家 | 先确认 App Store / 官方渠道、空间、网络和画质预设 |
| Android | 安卓与 TapTap 玩家 | 先确认官网 / TapTap / 应用商店渠道，不安装来路不明包 |
| 云试玩 / PV | 只想先看美术和玩法氛围的用户 | 不把试玩入口当作正式账号进度 |

## 7 月 21 日预下载后还要做什么

如果你已经在 **7 月 21 日 10:00** 后预下载过移动端，今天仍然建议：

1. 打开商店或官方渠道检查是否还有最终补丁。
2. 确认手机剩余空间，不要只看安装包大小。
3. 首次启动后先做资源校验，不要立刻切后台。
4. 登录前确认账号、区服和预约渠道是否一致。
5. 如果需要从 PC 切到手机，先看互通 FAQ，再领取关键奖励。

## PC 配置快速表

| 档位 | 建议 |
|---|---|
| 最低体验 | Windows 10/11 64-bit、16GB RAM、GTX 1060 6GB 级别显卡 |
| 推荐体验 | 32GB RAM、RTX 3070 Ti / RX 6800 XT 级别显卡 |
| 长时间探索 | 预留 80GB 左右空间，并优先保证散热和稳定网络 |

具体配置和画质建议继续看 [配置要求指南](/zh/sea/guides/system-requirements-guide)。

## 首日安装排错

| 问题 | 优先处理 |
|---|---|
| 搜不到手机端 | 检查商店地区、官方公告、TapTap 页面和渠道服说明 |
| 更新慢 / 卡校验 | 切换稳定网络，保留足够空间，重新进入资源校验 |
| 黑屏 / 闪退 | 降低画质、关闭后台、重启设备，必要时等待热修公告 |
| PC 老账号没看到进度 | 先确认账号体系、区服和渠道，别急着新开号 |
| 礼包没到账 | 检查邮件、活动页、领取条件和官方公告 |

## Page role: install and troubleshooting after choosing a download route

If you only need the official site, Steam, mobile, or cloud entry, start from [Sea of Remnants download hub](/en/sea/download). This page focuses on installation, updates, storage, account/server checks, and troubleshooting after you have chosen a route.

## Quick Answer

As of **July 23, 2026 at 10:00**, Sea of Remnants has moved from the July 9 PC open beta into the mobile launch window. A useful download page should now focus on entry points, account/server checks, storage, post-preload updates, and troubleshooting.

## Which Entry Should You Use?

| Entry | Best for | Launch-day check |
|---|---|---|
| Official launcher | PC players following official events and account notices | Launcher version, patch verification, account binding |
| Steam | PC players who prefer Steam library management | Store region, language, and account notes |
| iOS | Phone-first players | App Store / official channel, storage, network, graphics preset |
| Android | Android and TapTap players | Official site / TapTap / app-store channel; avoid unofficial packages |
| Cloud trial / PV | Users only checking art and gameplay mood | Do not treat trial access as formal account progress |

## After July 21 Pre-Download

If you pre-downloaded after **July 21 at 10:00**, still check for final store updates, storage headroom, resource verification, account/server consistency, and cross-progress rules before claiming important rewards.

## First-Day Troubleshooting

| Issue | First action |
|---|---|
| Cannot find mobile app | Check store region, official notices, TapTap, and channel notes |
| Slow update / verification stuck | Use stable network, keep storage free, rerun resource check |
| Black screen / crash | Lower graphics, close background apps, restart device, watch hotfix notices |
| PC progress missing | Confirm account route, server, and channel before starting over |
| Rewards missing | Check mail, event pages, claim conditions, and official notices |

## Read Next

- [Mobile launch FAQ](/en/sea/guides/mobile-launch-guide)
- [PC/mobile cross-progress FAQ](/en/sea/guides/pc-mobile-cross-progression-faq)
- [Mobile troubleshooting guide](/en/sea/guides/mobile-troubleshooting-guide)
- [Launch rewards and codes](/en/sea/guides/launch-rewards-codes-guide)

faq.answer: Use PC/Steam for long sessions and higher graphics, mobile for dailies and short sessions; keep account and server consistent.
